additional_info.subject: RE: ID0381493-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002516] OCPP connection not established CRM:00579001140
additional_info.body:
Hello Basheer,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked via SSH and found that-
There is network issue.
Also
SIM card status is not inserted
We checked Network operators as well, but
Not able to scan network
We tried rebooting the Router.
Even after reboot it says SIM not inserted
We suspect that- either SIM is not working or SIM port in Router is not working. Hence, need to check the both.
We recommend you to visit the site with working SIM and spare router. And your
laptop should have working Companion tool to configure router.
First you need to take out and check if SIM is working, and then you need to insert it properly (Not upside down).
Even if it does not work, need to replace router.
Do let us know if you have any other queries.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
